items.title: Netflix Titus Adds Single-Tenant VM Isolation for Containers
items.blurb: Netflix has added single-tenant Titus, a mode that runs one task alone on its own right-sized EC2 instance.

items.title: Microsoft Retires Azure Deployment Environments with No Replacement Product
items.blurb: Azure Deployment Environments retires on February 22, 2027 and Microsoft names no successor, telling teams to use Bicep or ARM templates directly.

items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle and SQL Server now support storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes
items.blurb: Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Amazon RDS for Oracle now support RDS storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes .

items.title: Amazon Aurora now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in transit.

items.title: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in additional Regions
items.blurb: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in two additional AWS Regions: Canada (Central) and Africa (Cape Town).

items.title: AWS Marketplace now enables partners to list once and sell through multiple subsidiary accounts
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces that AWS partners who operate multiple legal entities can publish a product listing once in their primary account and enable their local subsidiaries to sell it through direct private offers — eliminating the need to…

items.title: Amazon MSK Connect now supports updating connector plugins and worker configurations
items.blurb: Amazon MSK Connect (Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka Connect) now lets you update the custom plugin and worker configuration of an existing connector.

items.title: AWS Step Functions workflows now available as AI agent tools
items.blurb: You can now use your AWS Step Functions workflows as tools for AI agents through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
